verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Algolia has major-versioned API clients and a migration tool/skill for upgrading between major versions (implying some versioning discipline), plus an SLA covering official clients, but there is no documented deprecation policy, EOL timeline, or versioning changelog cited anywhere in the pack. missing for 10: explicit deprecation policy/EOL schedule, API versioning changelog, sunset notice process, independent confirmation of policy adherence.
